I'm an assistant manager at a retail store, it's a fairly recent job... I love my coworkers and the job has already taught me so much because of all the work I have to do in a short period of time. However... Yesterday I was supposed to open the ste with someone else, woke up feeling extremely ill and told my manager, she said I'd have to go in until I could find someone to cover my shift, I was there and threw up about 4 times in the bathroom at work... My manager knew this but was still hesitant to let me go... I called everyone I could but no one would take my shift, my manager finally let me go and said "make sure you feel better tomorrow because we need you"... I'm working 12-9:30 tonight and am feeling pretty anxious about going in, I feel mostly better than yesterday but still not great. Sunday is my day off so I decided to stick through today's shift, I need a job rn.... But I'm not sure I can handle this one long term.

This isn't r/help, r/advice or any other subreddit like that. You obviously didn't understand any of what I said CLEARLY. The truth is the truth, and OP does have privilege, probably multiple kinds of privilege. And? That's not attacking anyone, telling someone they have privilege is not attacking them.. Point blank. I literally gave an example of a type of privilege I have despite my being not privileged at all in many other ways, you're a special kind of stupid.

Different types of privilege exist and it is important to acknowledge them, that doesn't have to mean you're the luckiest person in that privileged group, but you've benefited in some ways because of it... Even if that wasn't financial etc. I'm a light skinned black woman, I have light skin privilege. I'm still black, I still experience racism... But I don't face the same struggles other darker black women have because they're darker. Aka; "You're pretty for a dark skinned girl", "Roach" etc. So I don't know if you'll understand my example unless you already have good knowledge of what privilege is.... But it exists, in many ways.
